picks.title: Meta will turn on product browsing in existing ads on October 28
picks.excerpt: Meta will default-enable its AI product-browsing feature, which turns any running Facebook/Instagram creative into in-app dynamic product pages, citing a 3% conversion lift from a test across ~117,700 advertisers; opt-out available.
picks.rationale: On October 28 Meta switches on AI product browsing by default for every running Facebook and Instagram ad. Advertisers have a firm date to opt out or prepare their catalogs.

picks.title: Google's Universal Cart shopping tool launches in the US
picks.excerpt: Google's AI-driven Universal Cart, which tracks prices and checks out across merchants, is now live in the U.S. across Search and the Gemini app, with Nike, Sephora, Target and Walmart at launch (YouTube and Gmail still missing).
picks.rationale: Google's AI cross-merchant cart and checkout is now live in the U.S. in Search and Gemini, with major retailers at launch. That is a new place where products get sold.

picks.title: Fox Expands Agentic Push With Eyes Set On TV Upfront Future
picks.excerpt: Fox adds new agency partners to what it calls TV's first end-to-end agentic ad platform and extends agentic transactions to linear buys, with digital next and the upfront in view.
picks.rationale: Fox extends agentic AI transactions to linear TV buys and adds agency partners. That moves agentic buying beyond CTV and into traditional TV inventory.

picks.title: Google Ads Search Terms and Ad Combinations Report (AI Max)
picks.excerpt: Google Ads is testing a single report tying search queries to the ad copy and landing pages served, including whether traffic came via AI Max expanded matches and whether assets were advertiser-provided or generated.
picks.rationale: A new Google Ads report under test shows which queries came from AI Max expansion and whether the copy served was AI-generated. It gives advertisers a new way to audit AI-driven search ads.

picks.title: Stripe agentic commerce revs up
picks.excerpt: Stripe President John Collison said agent-driven commerce on Stripe went 'vertical' in September, following its agentic checkout launches, in conversation with Meta's Zuckerberg and Alexandr Wang.
picks.rationale: Stripe gives a first-party signal that AI-agent checkout volume took off in September. That shows merchants agentic selling is now real transaction volume, not just pilots.

alternates.title: Thrad commits $1m in ad spend to AI chat apps testing in-chat ads
alternates.excerpt: Consumer AI chat apps can apply on a rolling basis for advertiser spend routed through Thrad's DSP — Monetization Fund II doubles round one's $500,000 to put conversational ad units inside chatbots.
alternates.rationale: Backup only. This is an ad-spend commitment, not equity funding, but it is framed as a 'fund' round from a single vendor, so it reads as funding or vendor promotion under the section note.

dedup.note: Picked 5 of 11, from 5 distinct outlets (PPC Land, TechCrunch, Adweek, SER, Payments Dive). Meta product browsing (history_match related to the 10-15 GEM story) was kept as new: it is a distinct product change (default-on product browsing in existing ads from Oct 28), not GEM model results. Google Universal Cart is Google's own consumer cart and checkout launching in the U.S., which differs from the 10-08 Merchant Center UCP hub and the 10-15 Newegg UCP integration (those cover the protocol). SER AI Max search-terms report (history_match related to the 10-10 text customization previews and 10-09 AI Max columns) was kept as new: it is a different report under test. Fox is a new expansion into linear agentic buys and is not the same story as LG/Magnite or Olyzon. Dropped: PPC Land Amazon Ads Agent (an analysis piece; the underlying rename was 9/29; history_match related), SER OpenAI ChatGPT Ads Account Managers (continues OpenAI's agency sales push, Adweek 10-10, with no new release; it was also dropped yesterday), Adweek Kargo (a podcast interview), itdaily TikTok Summit Korea (an event preview that overlaps the 10-07 TikTok AI ad updates), ExchangeWire C-Centric X-AT (vendor promotion from an off-list outlet), PPC Land Thrad Monetization Fund II (funding-like 'fund' framing from one vendor; kept as an alternate).
